reasons: The cited clauses meet the preferred position on every material term: professional/workmanlike performance by qualified personnel (§19.1), 90-day Deliverable conformance running from the later of delivery or acceptance plus subscription-term conformance for Hosted Services (§19.2), no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (§19.3), and a re-perform/repair/replace-then-refund remedy that is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims (§19.4).

The disclaimer in §19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty or stated remedy, so there is no 'AS IS' swallowing of the express warranty and no walk-away exposure.

The failed deterministic period check is a false negative caused by the number being written in words ('ninety days') rather than numerals or a month/year unit; the measured duration equals the 90-day preferred benchmark.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline and no counterparty comment are proposed and the paragraphs are rendered unchanged, so there is no over-flagging or invalid edit.
